description: Submit an MCP server, skill or plugin for review. Limit: one submission a day and three in the queue per owner. Automatic review approves supported low-risk MCP listings; uncertain cases wait for a person. Poll `status_api` (`GET /api/listings/:id/status`, no credential) to learn the decision. Each owner can submit once a day and keep up to three submissions in the queue. For a skill, provide its SKILL.md URL. An invalid body returns 400; an exhausted quota returns 429.

category.description: Category so the listing shows up under the right filter.

name.description: Display name; without it, taken from the source.

tagline.description: One line saying what it is for.

url.description: MCP endpoint, SKILL.md URL, the plugin's repository or the OKF bundle's `index.md`. For an OKF bundle on a domain you control, `POST /api/okf/ping` is free.

name: create_listing
title: Create listing
